messages:
nina-ops: Hey team — live all-hands: presenter audio very low on stream and the slides on camera are one slide behind the broadcast. Can AV please advise?

jorge: On it, watching both feeds. Stream audio is around -18dB, room feed at -6dB. Suspect gain mismatch on the broadcast chain.

karyn-product: If we can bump stream gain briefly thatd be great. Also the roadmap slide the CEO will reference is showing the older dates on the streamed deck. I have the updated export ready.

ops-bot: recording-backup: s3://redwood-recordings/allhands/3887665432 created.

ben-platform: Nina, switching PCM gain on the audio bridge +6dB; please confirm levels. Also swapping to remote slide source to match exported deck.

nina-ops: Saw gain change, stream now ~-8dB. Thanks Ben. Switching slide source now.

jorge: Noted a brief pop when swapping slides at 00:03:12. Marking for editors.

karyn-product: Uploaded final roadmap PNG to /mnt/share/allhands/3887665432/roadmap_latest.png and pasted link in the watch doc.

maria-ceo: Thanks. For Q&A follow-ups: pls add the Dedicated rollout ETA item to the backlog and assign an owner. I'll review tomorrow.

ben-platform: Editors: capture raw recorder at /mnt/rec/3887665432_room.wav and obs log /var/log/obs/3887665432.log. Proposed splice: 00:03:11.8-00:03:12.6 to remove pop, overlay from room.wav.

nina-ops: Adding postmortem note: root cause prelim: manual slide source still active on presenter laptop and broadcast automation didn't auto-sync; audio gain staging omitted a +6dB boost on the mixer's broadcast tap. Will fill full template after the show.

ops-bot: postmortem-template: /playbooks/postmortems/allhands-sync-audio-3887665432.md

karyn-product: Added backlog entries and owners. Closing thread once editors confirm processed clip upload.
